ck: (27)petacintaratnan nanu srutyuktapetopatya eva naprananyanityata aha — yatiti pratitapetaparanartatyako nirpicascetyaha — pratipasiketi virotyanyatarasyartantaraneva vacyan na tu pratitartasya nukyasatakatvakalpanan yuktaniti pava yatahEko ninansako pruyatvirote sastrayornita ekan pranananitaran tvaprananan pavetiti kincEvan srutyuktacakato nityatve prahnapi nitya syat satyan cnananityativirota iti cena visvan satyanityativatupapate anrtena hi pratyutaniti cakatosatvanucyatetvEtan paranartata iti prahnana paranartyanucyata iti cena `yatatatyatortanitivatupapate asatva prakrtepyasatyanahurcakatetatacna asatyanapratistan ta ityati nintyate ca etacunyavatinintananiti cet sanan tavapi atistanacnanaya prahnEkan satyanavasyakaniti cet pratanyaya cakatekanapi tata syat nispratanakaprahnankikare niratistanakopi kina syat nuktO prahnavasesa sruyata iti cet stripirva yanErva cnatipirveti cakatavasesopi nuktO sruyate sakunanuktaveva cakatavaseso na nirkunanuktaviti cet sanuktaveva prahnavaseso nasanuktO sanuktiraprananikiti cet nirkunanuktirapi tatEva yatra tvasya sarvatnEvaputityatina nirkunanukti sruyata iti cet asaneva sa pavati asatprahneti veta ceti prahnasatvacnanenasanuktirapi nahatanapurusarto sruyate svarupasatvan na purusarta iti cena nErkunyanapi tatEva nuktO svarupasatavapotakaprananapahulyatetatvacanananyata neyaniti cet evan pokapratipatakavacanapahulyaternirkunavacananapyanyata neyanityalan api ca srutyartanan vyavaharikatvan svarasata pratiyate prahnavatparanartikatvan va svarasata pratiyate natya anupavavirotat vinatanityatvasatane vEyartyapatesca Ekyaterapi svarasata paranartikatvanapatesca tvitiye citanasnapi sarvatra pratitaparanartyan patavati tyacyate iha tu petavakyanEkyavakyapatitaniti cena
